name: REN - DEV - WF-07 - Campaign Dispatch API_quicklink

parameters.content:
## WF-07 - Campaign Dispatch API

Implements `POST /webhook/renov/dev/v1/campaigns/dispatch` from T-1.18/T-1.21.

Auth: OAuth 2.0 Bearer JWT from AUTH-01 + `X-Client-Id`.

The SQL lives in `renovaciones-db/dispatch/intake.sql`; `make db-verify` executes the same statement against PostgreSQL.

Accepted dispatches are always queued quickly. WF-02B applies the 10/minute per-client processing limit and durable retries. Real sends remain blocked until Meta/WABA and Salesforce callback auth are ready.
